summary.text: Jon Nelson is a Republican member of the North Dakota House of Representatives, representing District 14 (home city listed as Rugby), serving since 1997 per the legislature's member page.

paragraphs.text: The legislature's biography for Nelson lists an occupation of Retired Farmer.
It lists education as Attended MSU & Dakota College at Bottineau.
It also lists Board, All Seasons Water Users, Rugby City Council, Board, International Peace Gardens and Board, Consensus Council.
Family is listed as: Married (Shirley "Sid"); 3 children.
For the 2025 regular session, the page lists Nelson's standing committee assignments as Appropriations - Human Resources Division (chairman) and Appropriations.
